newsitem.title: USA: Wesley Jessen sets up Brazil subsidiary.
newsitem.headline: Wesley Jessen sets up Brazil subsidiary.

text.p: Wesley Jessen VisionCare Inc, a contact lens maker, said Thursday it has established a subsidiary in Sao Paolo, Brazil, its 10th offshore company.

"With its large, fashion-conscious population and rapidly expanding middle class, Brazil represents extraordinary potential, particularly for cosmetic lenses," said George McCrary, Wesley Jessen's vice president for the Americas.

Wesley Jessen estimated there are nearly one million contact lens wearers in Brazil, representing a market of more than $30 million. Currently, more than 60 percent of Wesley Jessen's sales in Brazil are to people who do not require vision correction, the company said, noting a large potential market for the company's cosmetic lenses.
Wesley Jessen shares closed unchanged at 21-7/8 Thursday.
